title: SM ST7C
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time synchronous machine ST7C static excitation system with automatic voltage regulator, 9 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} sets the initial output voltage, {Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} sets the compensation resistance, {Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} sets the compensation reactance, {Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} sets the regulator time constant, {Regulator input filter time constant, T_G (s)} sets the time constant for voltage filtering, {Voltage regulator denominator (lag) time constant, T_F (s)} sets the lag time constant of the voltage regulator, {Maximum voltage reference, V_max (pu)}, {Minimum voltage reference, V_min (pu)}, {Voltage regulator gain, K_PA (pu)}, {Voltage regulator denominator (lag) time constant, T_B (s)} sets the voltage regulator lag time constant, {Voltage regulator numerator (lead) time constant, T_C (s)} sets the voltage regulator lead time constant, {Thyristor bridge firing control equivalent time constant, T_A (s)} sets the regulator lag time constant for first lead-lag, {Maximum regulator output, V_Rmax (pu)}, {Minimum regulator output, V_Rmin (pu)}, {Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} sets the oEL input location, {Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} sets the uEL input location, {Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} sets the sCL input location, {Minimum excitation limit gain, K_L (pu)}, {Maximum excitation limit gain, K_H (pu)}, {PI regulator feedback gain, K_IA (pu)} and {PI regulator feedback time constant, T_IA (s)}. Values come from the instance.
